children: - CopAur Minerals is advancing its Kinsley Mountain Gold Project in Nevada following a 50% increase in its overall mineral resource estimate and the completion of a Preliminary Economic Assessment. With a larger defined resource and economic study in place, the company is focused on advancing Kinsley Mountain toward its long-term objective of gold production.
